name: Victory Fellowship Church Mbarara
description: Vibrant Christian church in Mbarara - Sunday worship services, youth ministry, community outreach, and MoMo giving

data.title: Growing in Faith, Loving God & Serving Our Community
data.subtitle: Join a vibrant, loving Christ-centered family in Mbarara. Inspiring live worship, biblically grounded sermons, dynamic youth ministry, and life-changing community outreach. Everyone is warmly welcome. MTN MoMo & Airtel Money accepted.
data.image: african church worship congregation choir praising mbarara

data.heading: Our Kingdom Impact in Western Uganda
Weekly Services & Gatherings
data.subheading: Join us in-person at our Mbarara sanctuary or connect online via live broadcast every Sunday.

services.name: First Service (English)
services.description: Powerful morning worship, praise, and scripture-based practical sermon.

services.name: Second Service (Runyankole / Luganda)
services.description: Dynamic celebration service with live praise band, choir, and healing prayers.

services.name: Youth Revolution Fellowship
services.description: Music, dance, creative arts, talent development, and mentorship for young adults.

services.name: Midweek Miracle & Healing Prayers
services.description: Intercessory prayer for families, businesses, healing, and personal breakthrough.

services.name: Children's Kingdom Sunday School
services.description: Bible storytelling, memory verses, songs, and games for toddlers and primary ages.

services.name: Couples & Marriage Enrichment
services.description: Biblical marriage enrichment, relationship workshops, and family counseling.

data.subheading: How God is transforming lives and families through Victory Fellowship.

testimonials.name: Moses & Joy B.
testimonials.text: This church welcomed our family with open arms when we moved to Mbarara. The teachings have anchored our marriage and family.

testimonials.name: Emmanuel K.
testimonials.text: The youth fellowship helped me discover my leadership calling and music talent. A truly life-changing environment.

testimonials.name: Sister Florence T.
testimonials.text: God healed my body during a Wednesday prayer service. Truly a sanctuary where God's presence and love are real.
